No strict_canonical_like, SEMANTIC_WITNESSES, or lesson_identifiable hook is declared, so the strict semantic gate cannot verify the repeated-color teaching claim.
All 8 canonical inputs are accepted, but 0/60 default draws match any exact canonical (height,width,foreground-count) profile; all three bands have zero exact hits.
Canonical plus selected target_code form two exact-text groups although execution parity passes.
